about: Every doctor row of docs/platform/config/spec.md section 11, one source for Rust and Node. doctor and check are the severity per consumer (fail or warn); detailSeverity replaces them for a finding whose detail names the key; fix is an id of `fixes` or null; needsAcknowledgement marks a fix that drops a note. Descriptions are English; no row echoes a value.

rows.description: A config file does not parse or breaks strict-config.
The value a source gives, alone or merged with the others, breaks a section schema, or a key sits in a scope that does not allow it.
config.yaml and config.json both exist in one scope.
A project or global file is still legacy JSON; run fgos config migrate. Warns until every reader moved to Config.
A @fgos:doc line differs from the schema and standard render. doctor warns, fgos config check fails.
A described key carries no @fgos:doc line.
A value in a file carries no @fgos:why line.
A value still carries the [migrate] reason; replace it with the real one.
A value equal to the standard; it holds nothing.
rows.needsAcknowledgementWhen: the key carries a why or a note

rows.description: An account pool or the gateway token sits in a config file. The destination decides: equal there is the state after the copy stage (the finishing verb removes the source); a project file has no fix.
The global, accounts or token file or ~/.fgos/private is wider than its mode.
A file directly under ~/.fgos outside private/ holds an account pool or a token.
A migration backup is older than the stale age and can be deleted.
~/.fgos/private or the gateway token file is missing or invalid.
